_comment: B1 bypass_residual (Phase 4.2 L1 主推荐): cell_bypass_mode='residual' + learnable_alpha=True. cell-side bypass = gene_emb.mean pool (drug-agnostic 主路径) + alpha * attended (残差调制). 以 A4 no_pretrain 为起点 (A4 已证 Phase 2 预训练有害), pretrain_ckpt=null, lr_encoder=1e-4. fusion_dim 与 A4 一致 (448) 但新增 bypass_proj + modulation_alpha 参数, 全新 init. 预期 LODO 0.75-0.78. 详见 [Phase4.2架构改造规划.md] §5.1
